At Xpro, we firmly believe that safe and healthy working conditions in factories and other premises are as necessary and important as production, productivity and quality. Our policy requires conduct of activities to take foremost account of health and safety of all concerned, besides conservation of natural resources and protection of the environment to the extent possible. All necessary steps are taken towards our intent and policy of a safe working environment. We adhere to all Environmental laws as applicable at each location and are responding effectively to the changing regulations around plastic waste management. We further ensure that sustainability principles are embedded in our business strategies as well as in our operating plans. Employees represent our greatest asset and potential. It is only through motivated, creative and business-minded employees that we can achieve our aims.
